name: xfortin-skills-marketplace
description: Xavier Fortin's experimental Claude Code skills, incubated here before they move to Devolutions/skills-marketplace

plugins.name: factory-toolkit
plugins.description: [EXPERIMENTAL] Software factory: Jira ticket -> spec with a red oracle -> unattended builder, verify, reviewer and blind VM QA loop -> hand-back for a human judge. Builds and tests in QEMU VMs of the target OS, driven from a Mac (needs vm-toolkit)

plugins.name: vm-toolkit
plugins.description: [EXPERIMENTAL] Throwaway QEMU VMs of a product's target OS, driven from a Mac: build and test a worktree in the guest, launch the app, screenshots and input, the screen in TigerVNC (shared clipboard) or Screen Sharing. A skill and an MCP server, for any agent
